generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the work you are already doing. In every subject you will be asked to present your thinking and to work alongside others, and the people who do both well are the ones whose arguments land and whose teams hold together. Treat what follows as being about your own presentations, group projects and reflections, not about study in the abstract.

The same moves carry into professional life. Wherever you explain your work, defend a position, and share a task with colleagues, the ability to present with authority and collaborate well is what marks you out. Learning to do that now is a habit you keep long after you graduate.
